description: bits-ui's global id counter (globalThis.bitsIdCounter, useId) shared by components mounted, unmounted and mounted again: an id in the root's script; per section, a field whose value prop a template literal calls useId for (Svelte's memoized prop, computed when the field's $.prop reads it, before the field's own useId) and two bits-ui Command groups through shadcn-svelte's CommandGroup pattern without a heading (`value ?? heading ?? `----${useId()}``, data-value). Sections unmounted and mounted again by {#if} take fresh ids in Chromium's order; the ones that stay keep theirs
